title: Flex: A Foundational Proof-Producing Horn Solver
abstract: arXiv:2607.12226v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Constrained Horn Clauses (CHCs) are a versatile intermediate representation for program verification, but leading CHC solvers rely on SMT-based reasoning over supported background theories. Specifications involving user-defined recursive functions or bespoke operators can require additional semantic encodings and reasoning beyond these theories. We observe that CHCs are existentially quantified propositions in a foundational logic, and so can be proved within an interactive theorem prover, where specifications can use native definitions, and users can complete proofs when automation stalls. However, in a foundational setting, every Horn variable solution must be justified by a kernel-checked proof. We present Flex, a proof-producing CHC solver implemented as a Lean metaprogram, that combines predicate synthesis with proof construction. translated_abstract: 约束Horn子句（CHCs）是程序验证中一种用途广泛的中间表示，但主流的CHC求解器依赖于基于SMT的推理，且仅限于所支持的后台理论。涉及用户自定义递归函数或定制运算符的规范可能需要超出这些理论的额外语义编码和推理。我们观察到，CHC本质上是基础逻辑中带存在量词的命题，因此可以在交互式定理证明器中加以证明，其中规范可以使用原生定义，并且当自动化陷入停滞时用户可以手动补全证明。然而，在基础性（foundational）设置下，每个Horn变量的解都必须由经过内核检查的证明来保证。我们提出了Flex，一个以Lean元程序形式实现的可产生证明的CHC求解器，它将谓词合成与证明构造相结合。Flex包含一套策略：其中Zap可为无环Horn……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: Flex是一个基于Lean元编程实现的可产生内核验证证明的约束Horn子句（CHC）求解器，它将谓词合成与证明构造相结合，使规范可直接使用原生定义，并允许用户在自动化失败时补全证明。
en_tdlr: Flex is a proof-producing Constrained Horn Clause (CHC) solver implemented as a Lean metaprogram that combines predicate synthesis with proof construction, allowing specifications to use native definitions while ensuring every Horn variable solution is justified by a kernel-checked proof.
